$comment: Canonical tradecn tokens. scripts/sync-tokens.ts writes each item's cssVars and playground/src/styles/tradecn-tokens.css from this file. Color values are literal oklch() or var(--color-<shadcn token>) only: those are the forms the shadcn CLI turns into Tailwind utilities. The tradecn-font-*, tradecn-text-size-*, tradecn-line-height-*, tradecn-font-weight-*, and tradecn-numeric-variant tokens are the typography system (docs/typography.md): font stacks, px sizes, unitless line heights, weights, and the one numeric variant every number is set in, the same in both modes. The accessible stacks name their fallbacks in full rather than through var(--tradecn-font-sans), because the accessibility remap sets --tradecn-font-sans to var(--tradecn-font-accessible) on the same element, and a var() back would be a cycle that makes both invalid. The light marks (up, down, stale, expiring, panel-sync, link-1 to link-4) are tradecn-slate's light side, every one at or above 4.5 to 1 on white; the dark marks are tuned for shadcn's near-black, and down takes slate's dark vermilion so the pair keeps a step of lightness between its two colors in both modes (docs/color.md). scripts/themes.test.ts holds both.

light.tradecn-font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
light.tradecn-font-accessible: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
light.tradecn-font-accessible-mono: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

dark.tradecn-font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
dark.tradecn-font-accessible: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
dark.tradecn-font-accessible-mono: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
